title: GTA6 Weekend Gaming: Entering the Evacuation Zone
description: With less than two weeks until Rockstar's GTA6, gaming media Push Square shares what they are playing to pass the time.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## In the GTA 6 Evacuation Zone

Another week has come to a conclusion, and we are very much in the GTA 6 evacuation zone now. According to gaming media Push Square, there are less than two weeks left until Rockstar's highly anticipated sequel arrives.

As the countdown continues, gamers around the world are finding various ways to kill time while waiting for the monumental release. The anticipation surrounding Rockstar's next open-world epic has reached a fever pitch, making these final weeks feel uniquely prolonged.

### Passing the Time Before the Launch

Sharing his personal weekend plans, Push Square editor Jamie O'Neill noted that he has only managed about three hours on *Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut*. Because he simply cannot leave the masked protagonist stuck in a disease-riddled city, he plans to break out the PS Vita and finish the journey.

Turning to shorter experiences, handheld classics, or backlog titles is a common tradition for players looking to stay occupied right before a massive industry-shaking launch.

### The Final Countdown

As we tick closer to the release date, the gaming community remains entirely focused on the horizon. Whether you are diving into indie titles on handhelds or simply replaying past Rockstar classics, the excitement for the next chapter of Grand Theft Auto is palpable.

## Editor's Take

With just under two weeks to go, finding a game to kill time before GTA 6 is harder than it sounds. Whether you are dusting off a PS Vita or just waiting out the clock, the gaming world is truly in a league of its own right now.
